convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorBears indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing methods and trade execution logic. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters and custom smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) cannot be auto-converted to Python without manual reimplementation of the indicator and trade libraries.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds shift for signal time
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warm-up

other_exits: Buy position closes when ColorBears buffer transitions to bearish (Col[1]==2, Col[0]==0)
Sell position closes when ColorBears buffer transitions to bullish (Col[1]==0, Col[0]==2)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin, BALANCE=MM fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses ColorBears custom indicator with 2 buffers: buffer index 1 is a color histogram (0=bullish, 2=bearish). Entry logic: BUY when Col[1]==0 (was bullish) AND Col[0]==2 (now bearish) — this is actually a bearish-to-bullish transition reading the color buffer backwards (ColorBears shows bearish power, so color 0=low bears=bullish signal, color 2=high bears=bearish signal). SELL when Col[1]==2 AND Col[0]==0. The signal is read at SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) and compared with bar+1 offset. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as gate toggles for each trade direction. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation when CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: Requires full reimplementation of: (1) ColorBears custom indicator with its two-stage smoothing using SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA algorithms), (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh trade functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar), (3) GetStartBars function for warm-up calculation. The ColorBears indicator source must be located and converted alongside this EA. The margin mode conditional sizing (5 modes) must be explicitly implemented. Signal logic is color-buffer-based (0/2 values) not price-crossover-based, so the indicator's internal calculations must be faithfully reproduced.
